name: Ohtuvayre
indications_original: OHTUVAYRE is indicated for the maintenance treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) in adult patients.
contraindications_original: The recommended dosage of OHTUVAYRE is 3 mg (one unit-dose ampule) twice daily, once in the morning and once in the evening, administered by oral inhalation using a standard jet nebulizer with a mouthpiece.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
OHTUVAYRE (ensifentrine) 3 mg/2.5 mL inhalation suspension is a sterile aqueous suspension in a unit-dose low-density polyethylene ampule. OHTUVAYRE is supplied as: 
                  
                     Carton of 60: 60 pouches of 1 unit-dose ampule (NDC 83034-003-60)
                     Carton of 60: 12 pouches of 5 unit-dose ampules (NDC 83034-003-65)
                  
                  Ampules are overwrapped in a sealed foil pouch. The ampule containing OHTUVAYRE should be shaken vigorously to ensure complete resuspension of the active ingredient immediately prior to use. The used ampule and any residual content should be discarded after use.
adverseReactions_original: OHTUVAYRE is contraindicated in patients with hypersensitivity to ensifentrine or any component of this product.
